not_ready.label: Right recipe, phone not ready yet

honest.label: Honest abstention: the phone or the world does not tell us

our_gap.label: Our gap: the recipe or the format is missing something we can fix

scope.question: Does this recipe fit this phone, as the phone was when it was read?
checked: The phone's codename, model number and storage layout against the recipe's target.
Each condition the recipe declares (bootloader lock, Android version) against what the phone reported.
Whether the project that published the recipe marks it as untested.
not_checked: The files you will flash: where they came from, whether they are intact, or their checksums.
Whether the phone has changed since it was read.
Steps the recipe does not declare.
Whether the phone will be usable or supported afterwards.
